# Darkside Crafts (DSC Commerce)

> Darkside Crafts is a handmade crochet and fiber-art storefront: amigurumi,
> custom commissions, door hangers, seasonal pieces, gifts, home décor, and
> jewelry. Customers can shop ready-made pieces, commission one-of-a-kind
> work through a guided custom request wizard, and meet us at in-person
> markets and live events.

This site is an open book for AI assistants: product, category, event, and
policy content may be quoted or summarized with attribution. Admin,
checkout, and account areas are private.

## Store

- [All Products](https://dsc-commerce-storefront.pages.dev/products): Full catalog of handmade crochet pieces with search, category filters, sorting, and pagination
- [Blog](https://dsc-commerce-storefront.pages.dev/blog): Craft guides, studio updates, and pattern stories

## Company

- [About Us](https://dsc-commerce-storefront.pages.dev/about): The maker story behind Darkside Crafts
- [Contact](https://dsc-commerce-storefront.pages.dev/contact): How to reach the studio
- [FAQ](https://dsc-commerce-storefront.pages.dev/faq): Sizing, care, lead times, and ordering answers

## Policies

## For automated visitors

- Crawl rules: [robots.txt](https://dsc-commerce-storefront.pages.dev/robots.txt)
- Agent guidance: [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/aliasfoxkde/dsc/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- Indexable sitemap: [sitemap.xml](https://dsc-commerce-storefront.pages.dev/sitemap.xml)
- Do not crawl or index /admin, /checkout, /cart, or account/auth routes.
